# StatusScout

> **StatusScout** is a security and uptime monitoring platform for developers. It continuously monitors your site's uptime, SSL certificates, security headers, DNS records, exposed files, and more. You get alerts you the moment something goes wrong. Self-hosted and open source.

## How It Works

StatusScout runs scheduled checks on your websites at different intervals:

- **Every 5 minutes**: Uptime + SSL
- **Every 6 hours**: + Security headers + sensitive file probing + DNS
- **Daily at 04:00**: + Broken link crawl
- **On-demand**: Full scan triggered manually from the dashboard

When a check detects a new issue, you receive an alert via your configured notification channel. A daily digest summarises all open issues from the last 24 hours.

## Checks

| Check | What it covers |
|-------|---------------|
| **Uptime** | HTTP status code and response time; retries once on failure |
| **SSL** | Certificate validity and expiration |
| **Security headers** | CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, and more; flags version disclosure, HTTP→HTTPS redirect issues, and CORS wildcards |
| **DNS** | NS, MX, AAAA, SPF, DMARC, DKIM, CAA, DS, DNSKEY records; wildcard detection; subdomain takeover via subfinder + subzy |
| **Sensitive files** | Probes for accidentally exposed `.env` files, API keys, config files, and other sensitive paths |
| **Cookies** | Flags cookies missing HttpOnly, Secure, or SameSite attributes |
| **Mixed content** | Detects HTTP resources loaded on HTTPS pages |
| **Page analysis** | Checks for verbose error pages, missing SRI on CDN resources, POST forms without CSRF tokens, directory listings |
| **API docs exposure** | Detects publicly accessible Swagger, OpenAPI, and GraphQL endpoints |
| **Broken links** | Crawls the site and reports dead links |
| **Custom flows** | User-defined Playwright test flows (signup, checkout, etc.) — get alerted when they fail |

## Alerts & Notifications

- **Email** (AWS SES), **SMS** (Bird.com), **ntfy** (ntfy.sh)
- Per-check priority: `critical` (instant alert on new failure), `daily` (included in digest), or `disabled`
- Uptime and SSL default to critical; all other checks default to daily

## Self-Hosting

StatusScout is fully self-hostable. The stack is a Node.js monorepo (Yarn workspaces):

- **api** — Fastify REST backend
- **worker** — BullMQ job processor that runs all checks
- **cron** — Scheduler that enqueues periodic check jobs
- **frontend** — React + Vite dashboard
- **shared** — Notification utilities and issue history logic

Requires: MongoDB + Redis. No external services needed unless you want email or SMS alerts.

## Key Facts

- Open source — source code and architecture on [GitHub](https://github.com/Vincenius/statusscout)
- Free public scan available without signup (uptime, SSL, headers, DNS, sensitive files, broken links)
- Up to 5 monitored websites per account
- `checks.createdAt` is stored as an ISO string, not a MongoDB Date
- Lighthouse-based SEO/performance/a11y checks are **not** part of the current feature set
